muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server

# WithJSONOptions only exists under --output-jsonv2: without the flag the
# constructor is not generated, so a receiver referencing it fails to build.
! exec go build ./...
stderr 'undefined: WithJSONOptions'

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /events sse(Feed(ctx, marshalJSON(sendStatus)))" -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Status struct {
	OK bool `json:"ok"`
}

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Feed(_ context.Context, sendStatus func(s Status, opts ...SSEEventOption) error) {
	_ = sendStatus(Status{OK: true}, WithJSONOptions())
}
